description: This is a Spring Boot REST controller class for product management in an online shopping system. It exposes various endpoints for CRUD operations, search, and retrieval of product data, optionally filtered by categories and availability.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: Rest controller managing product-related HTTP endpoints, including CRUD operations, search, and filtering by categories or availability.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all products with pagination.

methods.name: getAvailableProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve available products with pagination.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific product by its ID.

methods.name: searchProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search products by name.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve products filtered by category.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new product; restricted to users with ADMIN role.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing product; restricted to ADMIN role.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a product; restricted to ADMIN role.
